meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared Support deterministic retired-booking path, Enterprise grounded answers, shared OpenRouter/Gemma failover, tool result replay guard and role policy against current source; existing private chat JSON location remains unchanged.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Cross-reviewed current-price cart paise precision, captured-INR predicate, shared idempotent VerifiedOrderService, actual-discount GST and frozen tax evidence. Order/checkout docs distinguish captured payment from saved order and preserve later browser-cart edits on retry.

content.review_note: Reviewed the Docs skill provenance guidance against the unchanged BlogService and authored-content guide boundary. Static map references are discovery evidence only; publication visibility, Markdown storage, rendering and private-help exclusion remain the existing source contracts.

foundation.review_note: Cross-checked merged Support/Enterprise/WebMCP/OpenRouter source against architecture maps and docs. No separate chatbot app, SQL schema, external chat plugin or production browser engine is introduced.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed public layout changes against existing Google Analytics and advertising tags. Google AI credentials remain independent of OAuth, analytics tags and OpenRouter encrypted provider key.

http-errors.review_note: Cross-checked the explicit Stripe namespace fallback against the existing canonical client and checkout call sites. RequestFailureService registration, CLI failure handling and exact MCP/webhook session bypass remain unchanged. The regression captures the real bootstrap before any fixture preload.

interface.review_note: Full card layout and mobile centered hero action verified by fixture; motion skill reference documents measured performance limits.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the in-panel reuse of original /contact form with existing ContactService persistence and SMTP mail queue; no automatic real contact submission, mass retry or new email notification route was introduced.

mcp-clients.review_note: Compared existing MCP client grants and owner-only tool restrictions against merged WebMCP annotations and OpenRouter model routing; the changes do not issue an owner grant or promote browser agent capabilities.

media.review_note: Reviewed product image paths and the bounded A2UI gallery against current media hosting paths; styling does not move uploads, delete media or expose private asset directories.

operator-help.review_note: Shared view registration describes the existing storefront rail partial; operator help and runtime behavior outside home are unchanged.

public-mcp.review_note: Shared view registration adds only native homepage rail controls; public MCP registry, schemas and actions unchanged.

remote-commerce.review_note: Home-only native rails preserve unchanged existing purchase forms and server checkout routes; verified full card browser controls and unchanged commerce behavior.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed the sales-channel CLI references and catalogue guidance. This change only fixes generic PHP lint argument forwarding and failure propagation; feed, channel and catalogue operations are unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Home browser fixture now uses actual home-main layout class, and partial registered in generated project map.
